description: Switch the MCP servers that AI assistants (Claude, ChatGPT and other MCP clients) connect to on or off. Every call made through them is recorded in Connector Audit Log.

fields.label: Enable Read-only MCP Server
fields.description: Lets signed-in users read POS data from an AI assistant with their own permissions; nothing can be changed through it.

fields.label: Read-only MCP Server URL
fields.description: Add this URL as a connector in Claude or ChatGPT, then sign in with your POS account.

fields.label: Claude Code Command (Read-only)
fields.description: Run this in a terminal, then open /mcp in Claude Code and choose Authenticate to sign in.

fields.label: Enable Full MCP Server
fields.description: Lets signed-in users also change data from an AI assistant (payments, orders, listings), limited to what their own POS role allows.

fields.label: Full MCP Server URL
fields.description: Add this URL as a connector in Claude or ChatGPT, then sign in with your POS account.

fields.label: Claude Code Command (Full)
fields.description: Run this in a terminal, then open /mcp in Claude Code and choose Authenticate to sign in.

name: MCP Settings
